subject: Contract exit playbook + alternate warehouse bids
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract exit playbook + alternate warehouse bids

Team —

DataGrid is asking for final pricing and an operational plan by EOD Friday. They just signaled they might exercise a 30-day exit clause if we can’t offer a competitive path forward for their growing analytics footprint. Two asks from me:

1) Can Finance + Procurement confirm the true outbound margins on Snowflake renewal scenarios and an alternate BQ (Google) conversion estimate? Ben, can you run a short TCO model by tomorrow morning — include data egress, storage, compute split and migration uplift.

2) Ops needs a concise "exit playbook" we can share: contract milestones, data export windows, KV cache preservation notes, security handoff checklist, and a list of recommended third-party migration vendors (Apex Consulting is the one DataGrid prefers). Monica, can you draft that playbook skeleton and include required Redwood deliverables?

I attached the latest Snowflake quote and a draft Apex SOW Apex sent. We need a single-sheet recommendation for the exec sponsor at DataGrid. I’ll take the external comms if we have the numbers.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Snowflake_Prices_Q3_2026.pdf] [Attachment: Apex_SOW_draft_v3.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract exit playbook + alternate warehouse bids

Evelyn —

Quick calc attached: BQ_vs_Snowflake_total_cost_model.xlsx. High-level takeaways:
- Snowflake renewal (current SKU + 15% growth): ~ $1.18M/yr list, with expected Redwood discount 14% -> ~$1.01M/yr.
- BigQuery (equivalent storage + on-demand compute pattern): ~ $0.95M/yr in base services, but migration engineering + tooling is a one-time ~ $220k uplift (est).
- Metabase (current BI) is unsupported on managed Looker levels; Looker migration estimate is +$140k setup + higher ongoing contract.

I added a sensitivity tab (5/10/20% growth). The cheapest steady-state is BigQuery + managed Metabase, but total 12-month cost favors staying on Snowflake unless the customer requires a hard cloud vendor migration.

I recommend we prepare two paths:
A) Renewal with committed discount + 90-day migration option and defined export assistance.
B) Migration path to BQ with paid engineering (Apex) + dedicated migration window and SLA for data fidelity.

Ben
Senior Finance Analyst
[Attachment: BQ_vs_Snowflake_total_cost_model.xlsx]

From: DataGrid Analytics Procurement <procurement@datagrid.com>

Subject: Re: Contract exit playbook + alternate warehouse bids

Evelyn —

Appreciate the quick response. To be explicit: our execs want a clear exit path (we are not threatening to leave, but need the option). Key items for us: export formats that preserve partitioning, transfer time estimates for 30TB of active parquet, and recommended partners for migration with references. Apex Consulting has offered a preliminary timeline but would like Redwood to confirm what you will/won’t do during migration.

Please mark priority.

— Maria Lopez, Head of Procurement
DataGrid Analytics
procurement@datagrid.com

From: Apex Consulting (SOW) <sow@apexconsulting.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Apex SOW v3 and migration timeline

Evelyn / Monica —

Per our call, attached is SOW draft v3. Short summary: 8-week migration window, data validation scripts, snapshot-based KV cache export guidance, incremental cutover plan, and a two-week hypercare period. Fixed fee $210k + travel. We’ll need a Redwood contact for export keys and an Ops runbook from your side that specifies table-level retention and any PII redaction steps.

Happy to iterate; we can do a working session on Friday to align on responsibilities.

Regards,
Jordan Hayes
Principal, Apex Consulting
[Attachment: Apex_SOW_draft_v3.docx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft exit playbook (internal)

Team —

Attached below is a draft playbook skeleton for internal review. Key sections:
1) Contract & timelines: 30-day notice implications, data export deadlines, custodial locks.
2) Export mechanics: parquet/Avro bundles, partition mapping, compression settings.
3) Migration roles: Redwood (export automation, credentials), Apex (ETL + validation), Customer (acceptance testing).
4) Risk & rollback: snapshot restoration plan, staging validation, incrementally switching queries.

Action items:
- Ben: confirm that the list pricing and discount math will hold under a 90-day extension option.
- Monica: prepare a single-sheet we can send to DataGrid with bulletized responsibilities and a redlines-ready SOW.

If no objections I’ll mark this as "exec-ready" by EOD and circulate to Maria at DataGrid.

Karthik
Head of Solutions Architecture

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <procurement@datagrid.com>, Snowflake Sales <enterprise@snowflake.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Apex Consulting (SOW) <sow@apexconsulting.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood recommended paths — renewal + migration options (one-pager)

Maria —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached is the one-pager we discussed: two recommended paths and responsibilities. TL;DR:
• Path A: Renew Snowflake with a 12-month term, 14% applied discount, and Redwood-provided export automation; Redwood to provide 30 days of complementary export assistance.
• Path B: Migrate to BigQuery: Apex on fixed-fee SOW ($210k), expected cutover 8–10 weeks, Redwood supports export + validation for agreed scope. Estimated 12-month run-rate slightly lower after migration.

Next steps: please confirm whether DataGrid wants the renewal amendment (Path A) to include a migration escape clause (we recommend yes) and whether you want Apex to schedule the FR/Planning workshop next week.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_PathA_B_OnePager.pdf]
